g.text: Charger interface block [S]: what each command does at U501

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: CE_DRV HIGH: U401 ch1 sinks /CE (charge enabled). LOW: /CE held HIGH (inhibit) by R472 and R472b to REGN.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: ILIM_REL HIGH: U401 ch2 turns the Q403 feed on and U402 turns the Q401 hold off. LOW: ILIM_HIZ < 0.75 V (converter off).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: RFC_OFF HIGH: U401 ch3 turns Q402 off and removes the FC clamp leg R457. LOW: FC clamp 0.65-0.95 A in force.
